description: DRAFT (scripts/block-face/draft-type.ts (src/canalRecall/blockFace/typeDraft.ts)) for the review turn. Timorpleinbuurt-Noord family 1910-1914, 5 storeys, 4.9-6.4 m wide: 47 pands on 4 block faces; median cornice 12.91 m, 3 window columns, wall #63554c. Pane layout, head kind, cornice kind, crowns and ground variants are NOT measured: see draft.unmeasured.

match.note: drafted: 47 pands, 4 faces; see draft.fields for n and spread of every number
